description: ARM storage account allowing plain HTTP and TLS 1.0
note: CIS Azure 4.1 and 4.15. A storage account that answers over plain HTTP and accepts TLS 1.0. Relabelled 2026-09-23 when KICS replaced Trivy on ARM and Bicep: Trivy's ARM adapter could not satisfy four of its own checks (docs/trivy-azure-arm-adapter-gap.md), so the trivy:AZU-* labels here are gone and the KICS query that covers the same control takes their place. Note the halves split between tools now: KICS covers the plain-HTTP half (4.1) and checkov the TLS-version half (4.15), where Trivy's AZU-0059 had raised for both at once.
